metadata.title: That 2 kill spree where I aimed at the ceiling and Valorant said ‘Here, take these’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, I wasn’t even looking!
Enemy must’ve been handing out freebies today.
Click if your best plays are pure chaos and zero aim.
